name: AccountUserProfile
title: Blocks/Account/AccountUserProfile
summary: One page for an Azion user's profile and personal settings, a page body for ConsoleLayout's default slot. A compact header (a 48 px `Avatar`, the name, a role `Tag`, handle, location and join year; no actions, the tabs are where you edit) sits over `PageTabs`, and from a 72rem-wide block it becomes a column beside the tab content with the bio under it. The settings tabs stop at the form measure, like the settings page; Overview uses the full width. The tabs: Overview, Profile and bio, Security and access, Notifications and Preferences. Overview shows five `StatTile`s in a `StatTileGroup` for the selected year (hidden on a phone), a `Card` with a `ContributionGraph` (a category `ToggleGroup`, a year rail of `Button`s that switches year over year, a day click that filters the history) and a `Card` with a month-grouped `Timeline` of contributions, or an `EmptyState`. The settings tabs are `SettingsGroup`s over flush `Card`s of `SettingsRow`s: profile fields, `PhoneInput`, `LanguageSelect` and visibility `Switch`es; `PasswordInput` with `PasswordRequirements` and a Change password button that checks each field, multi-factor (a `ConfirmDialog` before it turns off) and personal tokens, locked with an info `Alert` and a warning `Tag` when the organization's SSO and SCIM provider manages them; three scheduled digests and real-time alerts as `Select`s; `ThemeSwitcher` and a Keyboard shortcuts `Switch`. A docked `SaveBar` appears with unsaved profile, notification or preference changes (Discard, Save changes; Command S and its hint only while shortcuts are on). Loading draws `Skeleton`s; a load failure is a danger `Alert` with Retry.

variants.name: Preferences
